Ewave Product Calculator
=====================

[wiki link](https://wiki.ewave.com/display/LEGO/Products+Calculator)

Products calculator allows customers to input some data and would show them a result of calculation with products grid.

##### Frontend Features
User is able to open a calculator menu and input values / specify options (set up in backend).
After that user will see proposed products.

##### An admin is able to:
- setup product's range for calculator
- setup rules for calculation
- setup user's input fields
